notes.title: Time for show! Jelly Express is now available!
notes.notes:
Jelly squads!

We're thrilled to announce that the Jelly Express "Jelly Express" has finally made its debut on Steam!
We can't wait to witness your very first deliveries! Team up with your pals and embark on an exciting journey across the Jelly Continent? Get ready to tackle the unique challenges in Jelly land!

Jelly Express will be available in full in English, Japanese, French, Dutch and Spanish, supports both single-player and Steam remote play for two players, allowing you and your friend from different corners of the world to join forces and take on these exciting challenges together, supporting both keyboard and controller

What's more! To celebrate the game's launch, the game will be on a special launch discount of 20% OFF, don't miss out on this fantastic launch offer! ːsteamhappyː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1945260/_/

In the full version of the game, you'll have the chance to explore a total of five diverse worlds. From expansive gardens and intricate machinery to inviting beaches and mysterious underwater realms, not to mention the lush rainforests nestled within deep caves—each world boasts its own unique challenges and settings. In fact, there are over 70 levels waiting for you to conquer! Plus, keep an eye out for special puzzle levels featuring various and distinctive locations to discover!

Last but not least, we extend our heartfelt thank you to our community, for their unwavering support and patience. For those who have been following our updates, you may already know that "Jelly Express" is our team's very first try in game development.
Throughout this journey, every member of our team has been learning and growing. While the game has now reached its release, we want to assure you that we won't stop here. Our development work continues, and we're still passionately working on some exciting plans we've shared with you. 
The initial release might have a few rough edges and areas for improvement, but rest assured, our team will keep working hard to bring Jelly Express to the level we all expect it to be!

notes.title: Q&A Time!
notes.notes:
Hey Jelly squads!

[b]Happy summer![/b]
We would like to express our sincere gratitude for your interest in Jelly Express! 
Today, we would like to address some of the frequently asked questions that have come up since Steam Next Fest. It's time for some Q&A!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/67f0ed9bd2419f4f2140862f4a493ab1bcd03f5d.gif[/img]

[b]Q: How much content is available in the current DEMO version?[/b]
The DEMO version currently offers a gameplay experience of approximately 20-30 minutes, with a total of 8 playable levels.

[b]Q: How can I play Jelly Express in multiplayer mode?[/b]
The remote multiplayer feature of the game is still in active development. However, if you wish to play with friends and family in different locations, you can utilize the Steam remote play feature or third-party software such as Tencent Meeting. 
For local multiplayer, simply play together with a friend, with each person controlling a jelly character.

[b]Q: What new content can we expect in the full version? How many levels will there be?[/b]
Please note that the DEMO version does not represent the final version. In the full version, you can look forward to a total of 5 worlds, including the garden, shallow sea, deep sea, cave, and forest, featuring a grand total of 80 unique maps. Moreover, there will be a variety of puzzles and cooperative levels, each with distinct thematic elements. We hope you're excited!

[b]Q: If I encounter a game bug, how can I provide feedback?[/b]
If you happen to come across a bug while playing the game, we warmly invite you to join our Discord Channel [url=http://discord.gg/SGabHD9h4F]Here[/url] and provide us with your valuable feedback. We appreciate your support!

[b]Q: Can I play Jelly Express on my mobile phone?[/b]
At present, Jelly Express is only available for PC gameplay. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

[b]Q: When can we expect the official release of the full version?[/b]
Jelly Express is currently scheduled for release in the third quarter of 2023, exclusively for the PC platform.

So, for those of you who haven't had the opportunity to experience it yet, we cordially invite you to try out the game and engage in discussions. We eagerly anticipate your first express delivery!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/610d1b5175a2acf6671ac29daa34ec28b07ed93f.gif[/img]

See you next time, and hope you all have a happy wiggly day!

notes.title: Jelly Express | Mini dev log - The physics
notes.notes:
Hey Jelly Squad!
Hope you enjoyed the upgrade of our visuals! Now, let's dive into the [b]physics[/b] of our jelly!

[h3]First prototype:[/h3]
This is the very first physical prototype of our Jelly. Stretch, shrink, jump - that's all there was to our Jelly at this stage. Interaction with the world was limited, resulting in a stiff Jelly and a less-than-ideal feel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/2604cdeaa9ca2424a75587ad5992e9a20bd9a881.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/f76b1bd18cee76989b4b181d6a3d1517e0186c9b.gif[/img]

[h3]Second prototype:[/h3]
The first thing we modified was the jump - a hurdle every platformer game must overcome. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/33f56a8bbf4fb5ddbe327d6ff554bd0372b7704e.png[/img]
We broke down Jelly's jumping animation into three parts: pre-jump, mid-jump, and landing, and adjusted the physical parameters for each.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/29c127679dd1ca5895b2b7516f4b2dc98b7cec10.gif[/img]
Another important change was the stretch and shrink interaction. Stretching and shrinking are actions that need to be frequently used and accurately controlled in Jelly Delivery. However, the feedback for stretching and shrinking was far from sufficient in the previous version. We added two extra stages to the stretching and shrinking of the Jelly, known as "Super Stretch" and "Super Shrink" in the project, which correspond to the physical performance when stretching and shrinking to the extreme.

The last change was Jelly's eyes. After all, eyes are the windows to the soul. When flattened or falling from a high place, Jelly couldn't just remain unfazed with a poker face, right? Half of the eye interaction is controlled by the player's input, while the other half is left to the magnificent physics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/268b212e9e51528fce447a3666d82bfb8509ed6a.png[/img]

Even more…
In subsequent updates, we built a brand-new aquatic playground for Jelly. Correspondingly, we also added more physical feedback for underwater actions! Check out how the jellies swim!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/55801e21c577ce81ad06a5101ba67082fc018537.png[/img]

notes.title: Jelly Express | Mini dev log - Visuals
notes.notes:
Greetings, Jelly squads! 

Let's take a walk through the evolution of our vibrant Jelly World on screen, and how we've tweaked it three times to make it pop, unforgettable, and oh-so adorable!

[h3]First tweak: All about making you LOOK! It's design for the eye![/h3]

In the early stages of development, we wanted our game visuals to be eye-catching enough to seize your attention. We wanted to keep it interesting, without overwhelming you, so we simplified the amount of information conveyed through the art. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/7e06f362f9ec0391c9200781c5cde30bb6ef0037.png[/img]
At this stage, color and shape were pretty much the only visual cues. We went for bold styles, like the large vibrant blocks of solid color combined with thick, hand-drawn outlines to create a look that was simple yet impactful.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/05813681a03e707a27c0dd6043b85e06833887ab.png[/img]

[h3]Second tweak: All about making you REMEMBER! It's design for the backstory![/h3]

Midway through the development, after validating our core gameplay, we started to layer in a more detailed world view and story design. With the story guiding us, we continued the bold color block representation from the first phase, while our visual elements and atmosphere leaned towards a more concrete and joyful expression.

Each world's atmosphere was finalized during this phase. For instance, the initial adventure of our jelly began in a garden filled with a lively celebratory atmosphere. Hence, our first map lit up with enormous blooming flowers and festive confetti floating in the air. Other maps included the soft sandy beach littered with swim rings, the mysterious deep-sea harboring massive machinery, and so forth.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/d97a2880c68acd2d9dcee3c640be68262fdce2a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/981f10c8405bfe0eef41e8ad16a2d8f407258aba.png[/img]

[h3]Third tweak: All about making you LOVE! It's design to be cute![/h3]

Towards the end of development, as the level design became clearer, we made a third adjustment to the art. This time, our aim was to unify all five map scenes under a softer, cuter visual style that could reflect more detailed settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/d6e6fafb53b883830d02475267e6570aacb502fe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/769ea8677137e0e8a3c6e2ad3c254af2a12ee510.png[/img]
In addition to refining the scenic art, we also created many adorable character designs. They're all jellies, of course! We've got the energetic Sunflower Jelly, a master of machinery; the gourmet Dolphin Jelly, a cooking whiz; the shy Octopus Jelly, a stone enthusiast; the elegant Bat Jelly, a born musician, and many more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/610d1b5175a2acf6671ac29daa34ec28b07ed93f.gif[/img]
This is a delightful and joyous co-op game. We hope you and your gaming partner have an amazing experience!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/67f0ed9bd2419f4f2140862f4a493ab1bcd03f5d.gif[/img]

notes.title: [230310] New DEMO Update! With new levels, visuals and optimization!
notes.notes:
Hey Jelly squads!

Whats up! We would like to invite you to try out our latest demo! Which will be available from today and lasting for 1 month, we can't wait for you to play around with it and have some fun discussions about it!

For those of you who have already had a taste of our previous version, here are some of the major improvements we've made; 
- Added even more levels and challenges from the world of Jelly, which means you'll need to use all sorts of nifty maneuvers, such as stretching, jumping, and moving. And, to add to the excitement, there are some unexpected interactions you'll have to figure out to solve the puzzles...
